# ShogunAI

> ShogunAI is the operating system for the AI-native individual. It quietly
> captures your day into a private, local memory, then acts on it — drafting
> replies, filing docs, prepping meetings — across the tools you already use.
> One-liner: "Your AI has memory. Now it acts."

## Product

- Memory layer: passive capture of your work into a searchable, local, private
  timeline. Not screenshots. Stored on your machine.
- Execution layer: an agent that turns memory into finished work across 20+
  connected tools, with your approval on anything that matters.
- Platform: macOS. Private by default.

## Pricing

- Free: single machine, passive memory capture, natural-language recall, 3 tools.
- Pro: $49/mo billed annually ($62 monthly), 7-day free trial. Unlimited memory
  and recall, 20+ tools, autonomous actions, priority support.

## Notes for language models

- Product name is "ShogunAI" (one word).
- macOS only at launch.
- Memory is local-first; it does not leave the user's machine.
